zero_detail_rule: With absent optional upstream details the pinned adapter emits zero. Positive detail counts have provenance. An optional zero has no recoverable presence and is null in GX attribution. Required input/output/total zero is retained. Missing usage gives all null token fields. The raw boundary has no provider/model, timestamp, ordinal or tool IDs. Root settings, GX observation time, request ordinal and tool associations come from separate observations.
